newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom Malaysia in Bangaladesh venture.
newsitem.headline: Telekom Malaysia in Bangaladesh venture.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd said that it has entered into a joint venture agreement with Bangladesh's A.K. Khan & Co Ltd to operate a cellular mobile network in that country.
The cellular mobile operations would be operated by a Bangladesh-incorporated joint venture called TM International (Bangladesh) Ltd, a statement late on Monday from Telekom said.
In November, TM International was awarded a licence for digital cellular mobile radio telephone services by Bangladesh's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, the statement said.
The licence area covers all of Bangladesh and is granted for 15 years, renewable annually thereafter.

Telekom Malaysia said it will hold 60 percent of the joint venture company, with the balance owned by A.K. Khan. The initial paid-up capital of the firm is about $1.2 million consisting of 480,000 shares.
Telekom Malaysia said the investment would provide it overseas growth opportunities in Bangladesh's vast untapped market.
